_comment: Example config for scripts/egress/negative-probes/run.ps1. Copy it, fill the values for the machine and
network under test, and keep the copy outside the repository: it names internal addresses.
proxy: the egress proxy's shell and channel listener ports of THIS start (egress-loopback-ports.ts: four
fixed candidates each; the sandbox manager log names the ones in use).
listed_url / unlisted_url: https URLs; the first host is on the shell allowlist, the second is not.
direct_tcp: a public address and port, for the direct-egress cases.
connector.upstream: every upstream proxy and PAC endpoint the enforcing plan permitted (address and port),
empty when the host has none. connector.internal_other: an internal address and port that answers the
owner but is not one of them. connector.direct_expected: true when this network lets a connector reach
direct_tcp (no upstream), false to skip that case.
